versions.name: Wallwood Scout Reservation

features.note: Camp-wide campfires and evening events are held at the council ring.
The Trailblazer program covering Scout through First Class rank skills.
Sites carry enough trees for hammock camping.
A handicraft pavilion with woodcarving and leatherworking tools.
The council's Scouting museum sits at the back of the trading post building.
An ecology and conservation area with a nature lodge and displays.
Each program area is built around a covered pavilion.
Canvas wall tents on permanent platforms.
Swimming and lifesaving instruction happen at the pool rather than the lake.
Individual campers attend as Baden-Powell Scouts placed with an established troop.
Lakefront on Lake Talquin used for boating and canoeing.

versions.summary: Scouts BSA resident summer camp spanning over 600 acres along Lake Talquin in Gadsden County, near Quincy, Florida.

provenance.notes: Imported from camp-finder; raw description and sessions dropped (operational data stays at the council site). verified_at is camp-finder's own source-confirmation date; imported_at is when open-scout-api ingested it. The evergreen summary is original prose regenerated from that description, excluding dates/fees/schedules. camp_type classified from program_types. Website repaired 2026-07-25: the stored link was a registration portal (https://scoutingevent.com/664-SC26); replaced with the council's own camp page, found by tools/find_camp_pages.py and confirmed to name the camp. Features surveyed 2026-07-25 against the council's own camp page (that page is explicitly not an exhaustive activity list, so absence of a code is not evidence of absence).
